title: My Overemployed Nootropic Stack (For Insane Focus)

I saw Limitless when I was 12. Bradley Cooper taking a pill and transforming his life is seared into my subconscious. I can't help but test nootropics to try and get a similar result. 

Particularly when working soul-sucking boring 9-5s, caffeine alone wont cut it. Let's go through my current stack.
